 Hon'Ble Raj Beer Singh, J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned AGA for the State.

2. This application under Section 528 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (hereinafter referred to as 'BNSS') has been filed for quashing of entire proceedings, including charge-sheet dated 26.02.2025 as well as cognizance / summoning order dated 12.03.2025, of Case No. 188 of 2025 (State Vs. Laxman and others), arising out of Case Crime No.05 of 2025, under Sections 419, 420,
467, 468, 471, 504, 506 IPC, P.S.- Parasrampur, District- Basti, pending in the court of Additional Civil Judge (S.D.) / A.C.J.M. Court No.8, Basti.

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge (S.D.) / A.C.J.M. Court No.8, Basti
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the prayer made above is not being pressed and the applicants would appear before the trial Court and a direction may be made to the trial Court to decide the bail application of applicants expeditiously and protection may be granted till then.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has opposed the application.

5. In view of aforesaid, it is directed that in case applicants surrender before the court concerned within a period of three weeks from today and apply for bail, their bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with settled law.

For a period of three weeks from today or till the applicants surrender before the court concerned, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
6. With the aforesaid observations, the application under Section 528 BNSS is disposed of.

(Raj Beer Singh,J.) September 8, 2025 'SP'/-
